text: Draw exactly three red balloons floating against a pale blue sky, each with its own dangling string. Keep them apart so I can count them. Square image, no text. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?
